dataset: Our World in Data - Carbon intensity of electricity
notes: Country codes are ISO 3166-1 alpha-2, converted from the OWID alpha-3/OWID_* codes.
Aggregate rows (World, EU, Ember regional groups) are excluded.
Where a country lacks fresh data for the latest year, the prior year value is carried forward.
LI/MC/SM/VA aliased to CH/FR/IT/IT respectively (grid-tied neighbors); AD averaged from ES/FR.
